payroll.empty: There is no one in this pay period yet.
payroll.ready: {ready} of {total, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} ready.
payroll.allReady: {total, plural, one {# person is} other {All # people are}} ready. No one is left out of the export.
payroll.leftOut: {count, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} left out of the export:
payroll.readyApproved: A person is ready once their timesheet is approved.
payroll.readySubmitted: A person is ready once they submit their timesheet.
payroll.missingIds: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} no payroll id, so Gusto can't match their hours: {names}. Set it in <link>Settings</link>.

export.explain: A CSV with one row per ready person: regular, overtime, vacation (as PTO) and sick hours. Each person's payroll id goes in the gusto_employee_id column.
export.noneReady: No one is ready, so there is nothing to export yet.
export.confirmDescription: {count, plural, one {# person isn't} other {# people aren't}} ready: {names}. Including them puts time no one has approved in the file, and Gusto would pay it.

exceptions.scopeAll: What to settle before payroll runs, for everyone.
exceptions.scopeReports: What to settle before payroll runs, for the people who report to you.
exceptions.empty: Nothing to look at. Everyone's time in this pay period is in order.

sentence.clock_running: A clock has been running for {hours} h, since {day}.
sentence.not_submitted: The period ended and the timesheet hasn't been submitted.
sentence.awaiting_approval: The timesheet is submitted and waiting for approval.
sentence.rejected: The timesheet was sent back and hasn't been resubmitted.
sentence.time_off_pending: {hours} h of time off is waiting for a decision.
sentence.overtime: {hours} h of overtime in this period.
sentence.no_time: Nothing was recorded in this period.

action.clock_running: Stop the clock and correct the entry. Running time isn't counted.
action.long_entry: Check that it's right, and correct it if a clock was left on.
action.awaiting_approval: Approve it or send it back.
action.rejected: Ask them to fix it and submit again.
action.overtime: Nothing to do unless it's unexpected.
action.no_time: Confirm they had no hours, or ask them to record their time.

projects.scopeAll: Everyone's time by customer and project. A running clock isn't counted until it stops.
projects.scopeReports: Your time and your reports' time by customer and project. A running clock isn't counted until it stops.
projects.scopeOwn: Your time by customer and project. A running clock isn't counted until it stops.
projects.empty: No time was recorded in this range. Choose a wider range.
